name: PageGrove
summary:
PageGrove is a private immersive EPUB reader built for quieter reading on Meta Quest.

Bring your own EPUBs, choose a real-world 360° setting, and settle in with a comfortable two-page book, adjustable text size, lighting presets, and an original synthesized soundscape.

• Read in the Hohnstein forest or at the SCUT Library atrium
• Turn pages using direct touch or either controller
• Adjust text size, chapter, lighting, music, and ambient sound
• Return to your bookshelf and settings at any time
